column1: # Steps the cloud emulator cannot run, one per line: step<TAB>reason. report.py lists a listed step
# as not covered (gaps.txt) whatever its result and keeps it out of the verdict and the job colour,
# so the laptop census must run it. Until 2026-11-04 the android-36 image could not run guided, guided-queue and
# charge-schedule-wire (its BluetoothGatt has no mClientRegistered field for the synthetic GATT
# link); the 36.1 image used now has it, and they pass.

column2: the cloud emulator reaches the 'stopped check' assertion after the simulated 10 s check has already finished (about 24 s from app start to the turn, laptop 11 s), so 'A stopped check did not offer Try again' fails for base and heads alike; 2 or 4 cores make no difference
